verdict.rationale: Trilegal's Knowledge Repository publishes Updates and Analysis pieces on Indian legal developments, searchable by practice area. It includes ESOP-buyback tax analysis, a jurisdiction-specific startup equity instrument for Indian founders. Coverage is evidenced only by that one mention and is limited to India, since the firm has an India-only footprint. missing for 10: evidenced publications on Indian FDI rules for startups, depth or recurring coverage of ESOP regulation beyond a single buyback-tax item, any non-Indian instruments (EMI, VSOP, BSPCE), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: We examine a broad range of legal developments and bring you incisive content through short Updates or more in-depth Analysis pieces
searchable by practice area and year, incl. ESOP-buyback tax analysis
